tianxia.talent.source.quarry_walker.why: Nonmagical difficult ground the map names as loose stone, scree, rubble, gravel, broken tile, mine spoil or worked stone costs this walker nothing extra (the difficult_zone_exempt hook in combat/ext/source_sphere.py, asked about one area at a time by combat/zones.py difficult_cells). Mud, ice, water, plant growth, crowding and restraints keep their cost, and difficult terrain an ability creates keeps costing, as the printed text says. Because the exemption is per area, a magical stone area laid over stony ground still costs.

tianxia.talent.source.source_skin.why: Source Skin's standing clause 'You have Advantage on saving throws against being Petrified', on the generic defense block combat/pressure.py save_advantage already reads (an empty abilities list is any save; the same shape Golden Mandate Vessel uses in feature_blocks.d/paths.json). No new code.

tianxia.talent.source.old_mine_shelter_s.evidence: That creature also gains Resistance to the same triggering damage.
tianxia.talent.source.old_mine_shelter_s.why: 'When you use Mine-Shelter Reflex, you may choose one willing creature within 5 feet of you. That creature also gains Resistance to the same triggering damage.' One generic ally_damaged row (combat/ext/source_sphere.py) so the shared Resistance is weighed while that creature's own damage is resolved. The row is free because the printed 2 CP and the one Reaction belong to Mine-Shelter Reflex, which is charged once -- and ally_row_allowed only lets the row answer after that talent has actually been used and paid for, for the same delivery and for the first creature it reaches.
